notes.title: Demo patch v2.0.9
notes.notes: Fixed regression introduced by previous patch: Aspect ratio was broken when window was maximized.

notes.title: Demo patch v2.0.8
notes.notes:
New mouse cursor: it will now be visible during streams

Added basic anti cheat on client to keep the leaderboards clean

notes.title: Demo patch v2.0.7
notes.notes:
Start game balancing: set rodent's hp to 5, boar to 6, instead of 7 to ease beginning. Hopefully no impact on leaderboards.

Replace 'Gear:' by 'Weapon:' or 'Armor:' to avoid confusion about wearing both shield and armor which is impossible. The player can wear either a shield or an armor, not both.

Corrected typo in the game over screen: "enemies slain"

notes.title: Demo Update
notes.notes: After uploading the player's score to the Steam leaderboard, the leaderboards are now refreshed with a full list.

notes.title: Demo Update
notes.notes:
A changelog for the past minor updates v2.0.1-v2.0.5:

Normal difficulty is now known as Champion

Treasure chests can be sold again with "Sell all" button

Fix bug that allowed outside map travel

Add message telling if chosen difficulty enables Steam achievements

Reset button was not shown in Game Over/Scores screens

Hurt animation was playing even if damage was 0

Fix health max for Hunter and Barbarian

Left menu could be stuck open in some screens

Leaderboards now refresh after score upload

New game in custom difficulty should keep settings difficulty

Few UI fixes

notes.title: Playtest update #2
notes.notes:
This is a major version update, local saves will be reset.

- New rules, combat is now 1dx+att vs 1dx+def
- Swapped Worg and Spectre
- XP are fixed per monsters, not computed
- Focus bug fixes
- Right buttons are disabled when not available
- Add Steam achievements (unlock at normal difficulty at least)
- Add Steam leaderboards (at normal difficulty at least)
- Fast combat setting is replaced by Veteran and Voidcall achievements
- Add Reset button is restart a quickly restart a run

notes.title: Playtest Update
notes.notes:
Content:

Black arrow showing possible moves now indicates the button/key to press
Rename "Stats" button to "Bag" as it confuses players who just want the inventory
Add a message as why the button tavern is disabled (playtest/demo limitation)
